subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】sing English songs 唱英文歌; play the pipa 弹琵琶; do kung fu 练武术; draw cartoons 画漫画; speak English 说英语; swim 游泳; cook 烹饪; play basketball 打篮球
【重点句型】What can you do? 你会做什么？ I can ... 我会…… Can you ...? 你会……吗？ Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 是的，我会。/ 不，我不会。 Wonderful! 太棒了！
【A Let's talk】Miss White: What can you do, John? John: I can do some kung fu. Zhang Peng: I can draw cartoons. Oliver: I can sing English songs. Miss White: Wonderful!
【Read and write】We have a party. I can sing English songs. Amy can dance. Zhang Peng can do kung fu. Chen Jie can draw cartoons. Mike can play the pipa. Wu Yifan can play basketball. We are all helpful.
key_points: What can you do? 你会做什么？
Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 是的，我会。/ 不，我不会。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
